title: Every rookie to drive in FP1 in F1 2026
paragraphs: All 11 Formula 1 teams are obliged to run a 'rookie' driver in each of their cars twice during the 2026 season - meaning four outings are required in total. Rookies are defined by the regulation as any driver who has completed no more than one grand prix. Arvid Lindblad's rookie status means Racing Bulls had already satisfied the requirement on his side of the garage by round two in China.
